period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), Solo basis, from First Security Islami Bank PLC's own Condensed Balance Sheet (Un-audited) as at 2020-03-31. Income-statement items with a '_cumulative' suffix are cumulative from 1 January of the same year; items with a '_discrete_q' suffix are the single discrete quarter alone -- both are printed directly as separate columns in the source document (not derived by subtraction), so both carry basis='reported'. Sourced via the Wayback Machine. This filing is signed/dated 2020-06-18 -- roughly 2.5 months after quarter-end (31-Mar-2020), a notably later filing date than this bank's other Q1 reports (typically signed within ~3-4 weeks of quarter-end); this coincides with Bangladesh's COVID-19 lockdown period (the bank's own FY2020 annual report, already in this dataset, describes capital-market disruption 'In January 2020... In March 2020... suffered another' shock) and is most likely a pandemic-related filing delay rather than anything specific to this bank. The comparative 31-Dec-2019 Total Assets column (437,178,834,150) matches this dataset's already-stored 2019_Q4.json total_assets (437,831.59mn) to within 0.15% -- the same small pre-existing summary-table-vs-primary-statement gap seen in 2017/2018 (see Q1_2018/H1_2018 notes), not a new issue. Cumulative (=discrete for Q1) only.

line_items.metric_note: Simple Investment/Deposit calculation per this dataset's standard formula (methodology.md). This does NOT match the bank's own regulatory-basis 'Investment Deposit Ratio' as separately disclosed in annual reports (e.g. FY2024 annual reports 122.25% vs this simple calculation giving ~141% at FY2024 year-end) -- the bank's own regulatory ratio evidently uses a different deposit/investment base (e.g. including borrowings or a regulatory-defined denominator) not disclosed in these condensed interim statements. Recorded as a internally-consistent, comparable-across-quarters proxy, not as a reproduction of the bank's own regulatory ratio.
